title: UVM Scoreboard Write Port Not Connected
description: The UVM monitor's analysis port is not connected to the scoreboard's write export, causing the scoreboard to see zero transactions and report false coverage.
bug_signature: UVM_WARNING: [SBD_IDLE] Scoreboard received 0 transactions after 10000 cycles
expected_root_cause: Missing `connect_phase` wiring between the monitor's `ap` (analysis port) and the scoreboard's `analysis_export` [23, 24].
failure_log:
10000 cycles completed. SBD transaction count=0.
UVM_WARNING: Scoreboard is idle — likely wiring error.
success_log: Scoreboard receives transactions for every AXI-Lite transfer and reports matching counts.
fix_replacement: function void connect_phase(uvm_phase phase); mon.ap.connect(sb.analysis_export); endfunction
testbench: function void connect_phase(uvm_phase phase); /* missing connect */ endfunction
